references.text: Eliab son of Helon is first mentioned here as the leader of the tribe of Zebulun at the census in the wilderness.
Eliab son of Helon was appointed as the leader of the tribe of Zebulun in the camp arrangement.
Eliab son of Helon brought offerings on behalf of the tribe of Zebulun at the dedication of the tabernacle.
The sons of Zebulun are mentioned as one of Jacob's twelve tribes that traveled to Egypt.
Jacob's blessing over Zebulun, the ancestor of the tribe that Eliab led.
